findings.reason: MAST-U's last flux update at 96 passes is 4.652e-6, so a worker reading "converged" against a 1e-6 criterion would declare it converged at the current budget and never run the 500 passes the section exists for, and the set of cases clause (2) band-scores turns on that verdict.
findings.text: §10 clause (1) requires the record to state "whether it converged, the pass it reached tolerance" but states no tolerance, and the plan contains none: zero occurrences of the landed run's 1e-10 tolerance, which exists only in §9's evidence record, while clause (1) names the inherited items as rows, coefficient count and locked decisions only

findings.reason: whatever converges at 500 passes is band-scored as the fit's baseline, so without the misfit trajectory read beside the update a converged TCV is read as the fit's answer while it converged to a map its own objective scores above its starting point.
findings.text: §10's opening concludes "the result is a budget limit, not a verdict on the fit" from every walk still shrinking its flux update, but the same cited record reports TCV's misfit rising from 5.195 at pass 1 to 6.978 at pass 96, so on that case the walk is settling toward a state its own objective rates 34 % worse than where it began, and a 500-pass run will report that settling as convergence
